# Test fonts

Latin-subset TTFs of Google Fonts, as [Fontsource](https://fontsource.org) serves them at
`https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/fontsource/fonts/<id>@latest/latin-<weight>-<style>.ttf`. `test/textOutline.test.ts`
uses them to check that exported text outlines keep each font's glyphs.

All are licensed under the [SIL Open Font License 1.1](https://openfontlicense.org), which allows
redistributing them with software:

- Bebas Neue, by Dharma Type
- Cinzel, by Natanael Gama
- Great Vibes, by TypeSETit
- Lobster, by Pablo Impallari
- Pacifico, by Vernon Adams, Jacques Le Bailly, Botjo Nikoltchev and Ani Petrova
- Paytone One, by Vernon Adams
- Playfair Display, by Claus Eggers Sørensen
